subject: Recording + slides — short Q&A offer and priority check
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Recording + slides — short Q&A offer and priority check

Hi Samira —

Great to meet your team today. Appreciate the candid discussion about LumenBridge’s ingestion pipeline and where fast, predictable inference would make the biggest impact. As promised, I’ve attached the recording and the slide deck from today’s demo so you can share them with the wider product and privacy teams.

Quick recap / suggested next steps:
- Recording: attached (LumenBridge-demo-recording.mp4) + Drive link below
- Slides: attached (LumenBridge-demo-slides.pdf)
- Short Q&A: I can do a focused 5–10 minute micro–AMA to answer any technical or compliance follow-ups (SOC 2, data residency, KMS/HSM integrations).

If helpful, here are two quick options I can hold open:
- Tue 27 Jul, 11:00–11:10 AM PT
- Wed 28 Jul, 9:30–9:40 AM PT
Or feel free to drop a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/markus-redwood/10min

One question for you: is this initiative still a priority for the quarter, and who else on your side would you like on the short AMA (product, infra, security)? Understanding priority will help me scope the follow-up and whether we should loop in Solutions Engineering or our Private deployment lead.

Attachments:
- LumenBridge-demo-recording.mp4 (recording, 28:12)
- LumenBridge-demo-slides.pdf (12 slides)

Drive (recording + assets): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-demo-recording
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4832

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0149

Redwood Inference — production-grade inference for product teams

PS: If the ask is more compliance-focused, we can also share a short SOC 2 + Private deployment checklist ahead of the call.

Just bumping this in case it got buried. Quick 5–10 min micro AMA is available if you want to run a couple of questions past us (latency profiles for 2–4k seq, options for Dedicated vs Private installs for PHI, or a sketch of an evaluation plan).

Quick options again: Tue 27 Jul 11:00AM PT or Wed 28 Jul 9:30AM PT — happy to send an invite for whichever works.

Cheers,
Markus
